description: Repository model routing and Astra usage guards.

hooks.command: fallback='{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed.","systemMessage":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed."}'; repo_dir="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs" ]; do parent_dir="$(dirname "$repo_dir")"; if [ "$parent_dir" = "$repo_dir" ]; then printf '%s' "$fallback"; exit 0; fi; repo_dir="$parent_dir"; done; node "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s' "$fallback"; exit 0; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $fallback = '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed.","systemMessage":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed."}'; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $repoDir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $launcher = Join-Path $repoDir '.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher) { & node $launcher; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output $fallback; exit 0 }; break }; $parentDir = Split-Path -Parent $repoDir; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parentDir) -or $parentDir -eq $repoDir) { throw 'repository handler not found' }; $repoDir = $parentDir } } catch { Write-Output $fallback; exit 0 }

hooks.command: fallback='{"decision":"block","reason":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed."}'; repo_dir="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs" ]; do parent_dir="$(dirname "$repo_dir")"; if [ "$parent_dir" = "$repo_dir" ]; then printf '%s' "$fallback"; exit 0; fi; repo_dir="$parent_dir"; done; node "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s' "$fallback"; exit 0; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $fallback = '{"decision":"block","reason":"Astra guard bootstrap failed closed."}'; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $repoDir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $launcher = Join-Path $repoDir '.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher) { & node $launcher; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output $fallback; exit 0 }; break }; $parentDir = Split-Path -Parent $repoDir; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parentDir) -or $parentDir -eq $repoDir) { throw 'repository handler not found' }; $repoDir = $parentDir } } catch { Write-Output $fallback; exit 0 }

hooks.command: repo_dir="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs" ]; do parent_dir="$(dirname "$repo_dir")"; if [ "$parent_dir" = "$repo_dir" ]; then echo "Astra guard bootstrap failed: repository handler not found" >&2; exit 2; fi; repo_dir="$parent_dir"; done; node "$repo_dir/.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 2; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $repoDir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $launcher = Join-Path $repoDir '.codex/hooks/astra-guard-launcher.mjs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher) { & node $launcher; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 }; break }; $parentDir = Split-Path -Parent $repoDir; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parentDir) -or $parentDir -eq $repoDir) { throw 'repository handler not found' }; $repoDir = $parentDir } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Astra guard bootstrap failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 2 }
